name: hydrocortisone + salicylic acid + sulfur
uses: USE For relief of itching, scaling, redness, flaking and irritation associated with seborrheic dermatitis
otcwarn: WARNINGS FOR EXTERNAL USE ONLY. Ask a doctor before use if condition covers a large area of the body When using this product avoid contact with eyes. If contact occurs, rinse eye thoroughly with water Stop use and consult a doctor if condition worsens or does not improve after regular use as directed
